description: Verify a signature round-trip before money is involved. Bind the challenge to GET and /api/agent/auth/whoami with no body: ask auth_challenge for method "GET" and path "/api/agent/auth/whoami", sign the message it returns, then call this. A signature authenticates one method, one path and one body, so a challenge taken for anything else is refused.

signature.description: base58 ed25519 signature over the exact message auth_challenge returned.

walletAddress.description: The agent wallet that signed the challenge.

name: whoami
title: Check your signing works
